title: Uncle Ivan, the pilot
scene: Max's uncle is a pilot. He shows Max and Anna the cockpit of his jet and explains the radar, the transponder and the autopilot; then they visit an airfield and see a helicopter with a loud rotor, an old plane with a propeller and a glider.

scene: Anna buys a new high-end smartphone with a fast chip. scene: In the metro Anna's phone has no signal and no internet, so she cannot go online and is offline for an hour. Back on the street, twenty messages and an alert from the group chat arrive, and Mama asks why roaming is on.

scene: Anna's laptop is slow and full of glitches. Max, who works in IT, connects it to his computer, finds the problem in the software, makes a backup of her files on a disk with a USB cable, installs an update and does a reset; he shows her a keyboard shortcut, says his desktop at work is faster, and tells her that only the system administrator knows the college password.

She logs in to her account with her username, uses a template, puts her name in the header and the date with a slash, and attaches her homework in PDF format; then she checks her inbox all evening and finds his reply in spam, with a link to a reading list.

title: Max's new flat goes online
scene: Max needs internet in his new flat: a technician from the provider brings a router and a modem, fixes a connector and the antenna and does the setup. Then Max builds a home office with a big monitor, a headset and a microphone for calls, a printer that needs a new cartridge, a scanner, a tripod for video calls, and an adapter and a converter for his old plugs.

title: Anna's family tree
scene: Anna draws her family tree for Max: her mama, her siblings, a new baby cousin and the whole clan. Grandpa was an admiral and is now a pensioner who still uses an old telephone; Mama, a millennial, says Grandpa is a boomer and a true optimist - and Anna has his genes.
